title: Craftable Nautilus Armor
description: Adds a recipe to nautilus armor.
body:
Adds a recipe for the new nautilus armor (except netherite, that already has one). Works with 25w41a+, not 1.21.10 (modrinth doesn't have a 25w41a option). The recipe:
